new.text: 11.5 Post-build considerations This section describes some important behavior when using the post-build variant of the PDU Router. It contains no requirements, just important issues that need to be considered. NVRAM and RAM memory size can potentially grow if a new post-build configuration is downloaded into the ECU. Estimation at design time must be done to allow such grow so other areas are not overwritten (in case of RAM) or memory borders are not crossed. It is not possible to configure restrictions/locations/etc of memory in the PduR module configuration since this is implementation specific and relitevly difficult to implement (pre-compile and link-time does not really need this). It is recommended for implemen- tations of PduR module generators to extend the configuration with specific memory constraints if needed.
